title: Web Text Extraction Engine
description: Built a custom crawler to extract and clean textual data from websites for downstream analysis.
problem: Needed structured text data from multiple websites, but content was inconsistent and cluttered with HTML, ads, and scripts.
dataset: Public web pages across various domains, including blogs and news sites.
approach: Developed a crawler using HTTP requests and HTML parsing, implemented content filtering, removed boilerplate text, and normalized extracted data.
results: Successfully extracted clean, structured text with over 95% noise reduction, enabling reliable downstream NLP tasks.

title: Naive Bayes Text Classifier from Scratch
description: Implemented a Naive Bayes algorithm from scratch for document classification tasks.
problem: Needed a lightweight and interpretable model for text classification without relying on external ML libraries.
dataset: Publicly available labeled text dataset (e.g., spam vs. ham emails or sentiment analysis dataset).
approach: Tokenized text data, calculated prior and conditional probabilities manually, applied Laplace smoothing, and built a prediction pipeline.
results: Achieved over 85% classification accuracy, demonstrating strong baseline performance with a fully custom implementation.

title: Interactive Data Dashboard in Google Sheets
description: Designed an interactive dashboard for data visualization and reporting using Google Sheets.
problem: Stakeholders needed a simple, real-time reporting solution without using complex BI tools.
dataset: Operational business data including sales, KPIs, and performance metrics.
approach: Created dynamic dashboards using pivot tables, built interactive charts, applied filters and slicers, and automated updates with scripts.
results: Delivered a user-friendly dashboard that reduced reporting time by 70% and improved decision-making visibility.

title: Kurdish Speech Recognition System
description: Developed a speech recognition model to detect and classify spoken Kurdish words.
problem: Limited availability of speech recognition systems for Kurdish language created a gap for voice-based applications.
dataset: Custom-collected audio dataset of Kurdish spoken words with labeled transcripts.
approach: Preprocessed audio signals, extracted MFCC features, trained a neural network model, and fine-tuned it for classification accuracy.
results: Achieved promising recognition accuracy (~80%) on test data, demonstrating feasibility for low-resource language applications.
